description: This file defines the 'agent_ucc_listener' class, which inherits from 'beerocks_ucc_listener'. It declares methods for handling UCC commands, updating VAPS list, and internal message processing, within the beerocks namespace. It also includes private member variables and overrides for message handling.

classes.name: agent_ucc_listener
classes.description: A class that listens to UCC messages and handles various device-related commands, extending 'beerocks_ucc_listener'.

methods.name: agent_ucc_listener
methods.description: Constructor for the agent_ucc_listener class, initializing with BackhaulManager context, message transmitter, and UCC server.

methods.name: update_vaps_list
methods.description: Updates the list of virtual access points (VAPS) with the provided RUID and VAPS list.

methods.name: fill_version_reply_string
methods.description: Returns version information as a string.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_destination
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to a specified destination or default MAC.

methods.name: handle_start_wps_registration
methods.description: Handles the initiation of WPS registration process.

methods.description: Handles specific 1905.1 messages internally if possible.
